name: Haiti

flag.description: Two horizontal bands of blue over red, with a white rectangle in the centre holding the coat of arms: a palm tree topped by a cap of liberty, flanked by flags and cannons above the motto "L'Union Fait La Force".
flag.symbolism: The blue and red come from the French tricolour with the white removed, and represent the union of Black and mixed-race Haitians; the motto means "Unity makes strength".

hook: Haiti is blue over red with a white panel holding a palm tree; Liechtenstein shares the blue-over-red but has a gold crown in the corner.
trivia: According to tradition, the first flag was made on 18 May 1803 when Jean-Jacques Dessalines tore the white out of a French tricolour and Catherine Flon sewed the rest together; 18 May is Flag Day.
Haiti became independent in 1804, the first nation founded after a successful revolt by enslaved people.
